verdict.rationale: Streaming server-rendered content is a fair performance axis for a UI framework and its meta-framework, SvelteKit, so the axis applies. The pack does show SvelteKit offers prerendering/SSG and client-side rendering, compares itself to Next, and a user notes a clear split between what loads on the server and the client. None of this mentions streaming SSR or progressive delivery of server-rendered content, so the capability is unevidenced.
